title: Two has chains are independent
notes: Without `same`, each chain may use a different route, so YYC passes too; the contrast to `chain_same` (zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) has no has/!have/in/with/same chains or N hops; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.
